title: The Bull's Track
description: Brannoc wants to see if you can hunt. The Bronze Labyrinth is a good first test: it moves, and so do its hounds.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Bronze Labyrinth.
Report back to Old Brannoc.

title: Bronze for the Lesson
description: 'A charge needs weight behind it,' says Brannoc. 'Bring me labyrinth bronze. I'll show you why.'

stages.objective_text: Bring Brannoc 3 Labyrinth Bronze. (report to Old Brannoc)

title: Face the Warden
description: To learn the Bull Rush properly, you must stand in front of a charge and not flinch. Go back to the Labyrinth's heart.

stages.description: Clear the Bronze Labyrinth again, then report to Brannoc.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Bronze Labyrinth again, then report to Brannoc.
Report back to Old Brannoc.

title: A Lesson in Haunting
description: Cassian teaches warding by first-hand experience. Ashgrove Manor will give you plenty.

stages.objective_text: Clear Ashgrove Manor.
Report back to Brother Cassian.

title: Cold Light
description: 'Ectoplasm remembers the shape of a ghost,' Cassian says. 'We will use it to teach your skin the same trick.'

stages.objective_text: Bring Cassian 4 Ectoplasm. (report to Brother Cassian)

title: Hag-Charms and Hexes
description: A ward that stops ghosts must also stop curses. Grandmother Rook's bog has both.

stages.objective_text: Clear Grandmother Rook's Bog.
Report back to Brother Cassian.

title: Catching Lightning
description: Aldane wants to measure a storm that has a mind. The Stormcrown Eyrie has one.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Stormcrown Eyrie.
Report back to Magister Aldane.

title: Feathers of the Storm
description: 'Thunderbird feathers hold charge like nothing else,' says Aldane. 'Bring me some, and do not touch them with wet hands.'

stages.objective_text: Bring Aldane 3 Thunderbird Feathers. (report to Magister Aldane)

title: The Engine Test
description: To bottle a storm inside you, you must survive the Lightning Engine. Aldane will be watching from a safe distance.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Lightning Engine.
Report back to Magister Aldane.

title: Snow in Summer
description: The northern hills are frozen in high summer, and Sorrel blames the Rime Tomb. Go and see.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Rime Tomb.
Report back to Warden Sorrel.

title: A Spear of Cold
description: 'The tomb ice never melts,' says Sorrel. 'A warden I knew used to throw it. Bring me some and I'll show you how she did it.'

stages.objective_text: Bring Sorrel 3 Everfrost Shards. (report to Warden Sorrel)

title: Tides and Ice
description: Ice is just water that has made up its mind. Learn the water first in the Tidecall Grotto.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Tidecall Grotto.
Report back to Warden Sorrel.

title: Fire That Heals
description: Ilse believes fire can heal as well as burn. She needs ember ore from the Cinder Forge to prove it.

stages.objective_text: Bring Ilse 3 Ember Ore. (report to Sister Ilse)

title: The Burning Hill
description: The Phoenix Ashery holds the secret of rising from the ashes. Ilse wants you to go and live through it.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Phoenix Ashery.
Report back to Sister Ilse.

title: A Cinder in the Heart
description: 'Bring me phoenix cinders,' says Ilse. 'One for the ritual, and one to keep in your chest.'

stages.objective_text: Bring Ilse 2 Phoenix Cinders. (report to Sister Ilse)

title: Many Heads, One Heart
description: Brannoc's eye was taken by a hydra, years ago. He wants you to learn where they are soft.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Hydra Fen.
Report back to Old Brannoc.

title: Hunting the Hunt
description: The fae of the Hollow Under the Hill hunt people. Turn it around.

stages.description: Clear the Hollow Under the Hill.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Hollow Under the Hill.
Report back to Old Brannoc.

title: The Hive's Weakness
description: A hunter must know swarms as well as beasts. The Chitin Hive is the last lesson.

stages.description: Clear the Chitin Hive, then report to Brannoc.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Chitin Hive, then report to Brannoc.
Report back to Old Brannoc.

title: Tick-Tock
description: Odo wants you to watch how the Clockwork Foundry's machines time their strikes. Up close.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Clockwork Foundry.
Report back to Tinker Odo.

title: Parts and Timing
description: 'Brass cogs,' says Odo. 'Lots of them. I'm building you a metronome you wear on your wrist.'

stages.objective_text: Bring Odo 4 Brass Cogs. (report to Tinker Odo)

title: Precision Under Pressure
description: The real test: keep your timing while golems try to file you as scrap.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Golem Assembly Line.
Report back to Tinker Odo.

title: Missing Pages
description: Tolven's records mention a technique for stepping out of the world. The Silent Archive may hold the rest.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Silent Archive.
Report back to Archivist Tolven.

title: A Moment Out of Time
description: Stepping out of the world means stepping out of time. The Clocktower of Stopped Hours will teach you.

stages.description: Clear the Clocktower of Stopped Hours.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Clocktower of Stopped Hours.
Report back to Archivist Tolven.

title: The Edge of Nothing
description: The last lesson is in the Hollow of Unmaking. Bring back a drop of void, and yourself.

stages.objective_text: Bring Tolven 1 Void Essence. (report to Archivist Tolven)

title: Petrified Research
description: Aldane wants to study a gorgon's gaze without turning to stone. You'll be collecting the samples.

stages.objective_text: Bring Aldane 3 Gorgon Tears. (report to Magister Aldane)

title: Into the Garden
description: Samples are not enough. Aldane needs you to face the garden's master and live.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Gorgon's Garden.
Report back to Magister Aldane.

title: A Reflection's Weight
description: A gaze works both ways. Learn to bear your own reflection in the Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors.

stages.description: Clear the Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors.
Report back to Magister Aldane.

title: Know Your Poison
description: Mabb's first rule: you don't use a poison you haven't survived. The Bog has plenty.

stages.objective_text: Clear Grandmother Rook's Bog.
Report back to Sergeant Mabb.

title: Hive Venom
description: 'The best venom in Aethoria is in the Chitin Hive,' says Mabb. 'Bring me the jelly. The venom comes with it.'

stages.objective_text: Bring Mabb 3 Royal Jelly. (report to Sergeant Mabb)

title: A Clean Cut
description: Finish your training where the poison of the old plague still lingers: Saint Vera's Asylum.

stages.objective_text: Clear Saint Vera's Asylum.
Report back to Sergeant Mabb.

title: Bronze That Moves
description: Halvard has heard of a bronze that rearranges itself. He wants it for an axe.

stages.objective_text: Bring Halvard 4 Labyrinth Bronze. (report to Forgemaster Halvard)

title: Fire Worthy of It
description: 'Normal coal won't melt that bronze,' Halvard says. 'Bring me ember ore from the Cinder Forge.'

stages.objective_text: Bring Halvard 3 Ember Ore. (report to Forgemaster Halvard)

title: The Horn
description: An axe like that needs a horn from the Labyrinth's warden. Asterion's, if he's still there. Whoever holds it now, if not.

stages.description: Clear the Bronze Labyrinth, then report to Halvard.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Bronze Labyrinth, then report to Halvard.
Report back to Forgemaster Halvard.

title: Dew That Sings
description: Ilse wants to make a circlet that helps the wearer think clearly. Fae dewglass is the key.

stages.objective_text: Bring Ilse 3 Fae Dewglass. (report to Sister Ilse)

title: Pearls of the Tide
description: The setting must be tide pearls, says Ilse, for balance.

stages.objective_text: Bring Ilse 2 Tide Pearls. (report to Sister Ilse)

title: A Fae Blessing
description: A fae thing must be blessed by the fae. Go back under the hill, and make sure whoever rules there knows your name.

stages.description: Clear the Hollow Under the Hill.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Hollow Under the Hill.
Report back to Sister Ilse.

title: Scales That Grow Back
description: Halvard wants hydra scales for a mail that mends itself.

stages.objective_text: Bring Halvard 5 Hydra Scales. (report to Forgemaster Halvard)

title: A Living Frame
description: 'Scales need a frame that lives,' Halvard says. 'Heartstone from the Rootdeep Caverns.'

stages.objective_text: Bring Halvard 3 Heartstone Chips. (report to Forgemaster Halvard)

title: Proving the Mail
description: Before he'll hand it over, Halvard wants proof you can survive the fen it came from.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Hydra Fen.
Report back to Forgemaster Halvard.

title: A Collector's Whim
description: Lady Vos wants a sword that sees the future. She has a smith ready, and needs haunted mirror glass.

stages.objective_text: Bring Lady Vos 4 Silvered Shards. (report to Lady Seraphine Vos)

title: Metal From the Sky
description: The blade itself must be star metal from the Starfall Crater.

stages.objective_text: Bring Lady Vos 3 Star Metal. (report to Lady Seraphine Vos)

title: The Blade's First Reflection
description: A mirror-blade must be tempered in the place the mirrors came from.

stages.description: Clear the Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors.
Report back to Lady Seraphine Vos.

title: Bottled Lightning
description: Aldane needs storm capacitors from the Lightning Engine, intact.

stages.objective_text: Bring Aldane 3 Storm Capacitors. (report to Magister Aldane)

title: Feathers to Bind It
description: Thunderbird feathers will hold the charge in the staff.

stages.objective_text: Bring Aldane 3 Thunderbird Feathers. (report to Magister Aldane)

title: Calibration
description: Aldane needs to calibrate the staff against a real storm. Take it to the Eyrie.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Stormcrown Eyrie.
Report back to Magister Aldane.

title: Ice for a Lining
description: Sorrel's wardens freeze on the northern roads. She wants a cloak lined with everfrost.

stages.objective_text: Bring Sorrel 3 Everfrost Shards. (report to Warden Sorrel)

title: Ghost Thread
description: To keep the cold in and the ghosts out, the cloak must be sewn with ectoplasm.

stages.objective_text: Bring Sorrel 3 Ectoplasm. (report to Warden Sorrel)

title: Tested in the Tomb
description: Wear it into the Rime Tomb. If you come out warm, it works.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Rime Tomb.
Report back to Warden Sorrel.

title: Cogs, Many Cogs
description: Odo is building gauntlets. He needs brass cogs, and lots of them.

stages.objective_text: Bring Odo 3 Brass Cogs. (report to Tinker Odo)

title: Something to Power Them
description: The gauntlets need golem cores to drive the gears.

stages.objective_text: Bring Odo 2 Golem Core Fragments. (report to Tinker Odo)

title: Field Test
description: 'Wear them into the Assembly Line,' says Odo. 'If they survive, so will you. Probably.'

stages.objective_text: Clear the Golem Assembly Line.
Report back to Tinker Odo.

title: Bronze of the Bells
description: Cassian wants to make a mantle that holds back the dead. It starts with bell-bronze from Bellfall Cathedral.

stages.objective_text: Bring Cassian 3 Cracked Bell Bronze. (report to Brother Cassian)

title: Feathers of Light
description: The mantle must be sewn with seraph feathers from the Dawnspire Observatory.

stages.objective_text: Bring Cassian 3 Seraph Feathers. (report to Brother Cassian)

title: Blessed in the Dark
description: Cassian will bless the mantle, but only after you've worn it through the Cathedral of Bellfall.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Cathedral of Bellfall.
Report back to Brother Cassian.

title: Scales of a Dragon
description: Halvard wants dragon scale. He says it like other people say 'a cup of tea'.

stages.objective_text: Bring Halvard 4 Dragon Scales. (report to Forgemaster Halvard)

title: Fire to Quench It
description: Dragon scale can only be tempered in phoenix fire.

stages.objective_text: Bring Halvard 3 Phoenix Cinders. (report to Forgemaster Halvard)

title: The Dragon's Leave
description: Halvard won't finish it until the hoard's master knows who wears its scales.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Hoard of Vael-Ashar.
Report back to Forgemaster Halvard.

title: Threads of Dream
description: Lady Vos wants the rarest thing in Aethoria for her cabinet: a ring spun from a dream. Start with dream ichor.

stages.objective_text: Bring Lady Vos 3 Dream Ichor. (report to Lady Seraphine Vos)

title: A Moment and a Nothing
description: The ring must be set with a chronoshard and a bead of void.

stages.description: Bring Lady Vos 1 Chronoshard and 1 Void Essence.
stages.objective_text: Bring Lady Vos 1 Chronoshard and 1 Void Essence. (report to Lady Seraphine Vos)

title: Wake Up Holding It
description: To finish the ring, someone must carry it through the Dreamer's Abyss and wake up.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Dreamer's Abyss.
Report back to Lady Seraphine Vos.

title: Toll Road
description: The Redcaps are charging a toll on the village road, and Captain Venn wants it stopped.

stages.objective_text: Bring Venn 3 Redcap Insignia. (report to Captain Dara Venn)

title: The Chief's Cap
description: Venn wants the Redcap chief, whoever it is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear Redcap Fortress.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Hold the Road
description: The road must stay safe. Venn wants you to reach level 5 and prove you can keep it that way.

stages.objective_text: Reach level 5.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: The Lights in the Window
description: Ilse has watched the lights in Ashgrove Manor every night. She wants to know who's home.

stages.objective_text: Clear Ashgrove Manor.
Report back to Sister Ilse.

title: Proof of Haunting
description: The village elders don't believe in ghosts, even now. Ilse wants proof.

stages.objective_text: Bring Ilse 2 Ectoplasm. (report to Sister Ilse)

title: The Lady's Rest
description: Lady Ashgrove still burns. Ilse wants her laid to rest.

stages.description: Slay any Lady of Ashgrove Manor.
stages.objective_text: Slay any Lady of Ashgrove Manor.
Report back to Sister Ilse.

title: The Machines Won't Stop
description: The Clockwork Foundry is shaking the ground under Odo's workshop. He wants it shut down.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Clockwork Foundry.
Report back to Tinker Odo.

title: Spare Parts
description: Odo wants to make sure the Foundry can't rebuild too quickly. Steal its parts.

stages.objective_text: Bring Odo 3 Brass Cogs. (report to Tinker Odo)

title: Mapping the Roots
description: Petra needs someone to walk the Rootdeep Caverns and come back.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Rootdeep Caverns.
Report back to Petra the Cartographer.

title: Living Stone
description: Petra needs a heartstone chip to calibrate her compass for the caves.

stages.objective_text: Bring Petra 2 Heartstone Chips. (report to Petra the Cartographer)

title: The Dogs Are Dreaming
description: Every dog in the village is dreaming at once. Ilse blames the spores from the Mycelial Kingdom.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Mycelial Kingdom.
Report back to Sister Ilse.

title: A Cure From the Cause
description: Ilse thinks the spores can make their own cure.

stages.objective_text: Bring Ilse 3 Glowcap Spore Sacs. (report to Sister Ilse)

title: Quality Control
description: Odo has heard the Golem Assembly Line is still building. He wants to know what.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Golem Assembly Line.
Report back to Tinker Odo.

title: Core Samples
description: Odo wants golem cores to see whether they can be made to do honest work.

stages.objective_text: Bring Odo 2 Golem Core Fragments. (report to Tinker Odo)

title: Rival Forge
description: Halvard has heard the Cinder Forge has a new master. He wants to know if it's competition.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Cinder Forge.
Report back to Forgemaster Halvard.

title: A Sample of the Ore
description: Whoever is working the Forge, Halvard wants a sample of their ore.

stages.objective_text: Bring Halvard 3 Ember Ore. (report to Forgemaster Halvard)

title: Lost Hours
description: Travellers who camp too near the mushroom ring lose a day. Sorrel wants to know why.

stages.description: Clear the Hollow Under the Hill.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Hollow Under the Hill.
Report back to Warden Sorrel.

title: Fair Trade
description: The fae deal in fair trades. Bring dewglass and Sorrel will bargain for the travellers' lost time.

stages.objective_text: Bring Sorrel 2 Fae Dewglass. (report to Warden Sorrel)

title: The Crown Under the Hill
description: Whoever wears the crown under the hill must be told the road is not theirs.

stages.description: Slay the Queen of the Hollow or the Changeling Prince.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Queen of the Hollow or the Changeling Prince.
Report back to Warden Sorrel.

title: Missing Sheep
description: Sheep are vanishing near the camp, and Cassian smells witchcraft.

stages.objective_text: Clear Grandmother Rook's Bog.
Report back to Brother Cassian.

title: Evidence
description: Cassian wants witch charms as evidence for the city magistrate.

stages.objective_text: Bring Cassian 3 Hag's Charms. (report to Brother Cassian)

title: The Grandmother's Fate
description: Cassian wants Grandmother Rook, or whatever took her place, stopped for good.

stages.description: Slay Grandmother Rook or the Bog Wife.
stages.objective_text: Slay Grandmother Rook or the Bog Wife.
Report back to Brother Cassian.

title: A Sea Without a Sea
description: There is a sea cave a hundred miles from any sea. Petra wants it mapped.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Tidecall Grotto.
Report back to Petra the Cartographer.

title: Tide Charts
description: Petra needs tide pearls to predict the impossible tide.

stages.objective_text: Bring Petra 2 Tide Pearls. (report to Petra the Cartographer)

title: The Drowned Orchard
description: Farmers south of the village have lost their orchard to the Hydra Fen. Venn wants it reclaimed.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Hydra Fen.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Proof of the Kill
description: Venn's bounty office wants proof. Hydra scales will do.

stages.objective_text: Bring Venn 4 Hydra Scales. (report to Captain Dara Venn)

title: Every Head
description: The fen keeps growing new heads. Venn wants the line ended.

stages.description: Slay the Fen Hydra or the Cauterized Hydra.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Fen Hydra or the Cauterized Hydra.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: The Toyshop
description: Children in Verath keep going missing near an old toyshop. Venn wants it searched.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Dollmaker's Workshop.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Porcelain Faces
description: Some of the dolls have faces like the missing children. Venn wants the pieces.

stages.objective_text: Bring Venn 3 Haunted Porcelain. (report to Captain Dara Venn)

title: The Maker
description: Venn wants whoever makes the dolls stopped.

stages.description: Slay the Master Dollmaker or the Doll Queen.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Master Dollmaker or the Doll Queen.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: The Archmage's Notes
description: Tolven has records of an archmage in the Drowned Sanctum on Floor 3, studying the Fracture. He wants the notes, and the scholar stopped.

stages.description: Slay the archmage of the Drowned Sanctum.
stages.objective_text: Slay the archmage of the Drowned Sanctum.
Report back to Archivist Tolven.

title: What Came Back
description: Tolven's records say archmages in that sanctum don't stay dead. Prove him wrong.

stages.description: Slay the Hollow Lich, or the Ashen Cabal.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Hollow Lich, or the Ashen Cabal.
Report back to Archivist Tolven.

title: The Cleansing That Failed
description: The Order of the Pale Lamp went down to cleanse the sanctum. Tolven wants to know what happened to them.

stages.description: Slay the Order of the Pale Lamp.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Order of the Pale Lamp.
Report back to Archivist Tolven.

title: The Kings in the Ice
description: Tolven wants the names of the kings buried in the Rime Tomb.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Rime Tomb.
Report back to Archivist Tolven.

title: Ice for the Archive
description: Tolven wants everfrost to preserve his oldest records.

stages.objective_text: Bring Tolven 2 Everfrost Shards. (report to Archivist Tolven)

title: The Lost Ward
description: Saint Vera's Asylum kept records of every patient. Tolven wants them.

stages.objective_text: Clear Saint Vera's Asylum.
Report back to Archivist Tolven.

title: Ash for the Cure
description: Ilse has asked Tolven for plague ash to study. He wants you to fetch it.

stages.objective_text: Bring Tolven 3 Plague Ash. (report to Archivist Tolven)

title: The Doctor's Fate
description: The records end with the Plague Doctor. Tolven wants to know what became of him.

stages.description: Slay the Plague Doctor or the Grey Plague.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Plague Doctor or the Grey Plague.
Report back to Archivist Tolven.

title: The Ship in the Sky
description: Petra wants the skyship's charts. They might show how the world looked before the Fracture.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Derelict Skyship Meridian.
Report back to Petra the Cartographer.

title: Aether Coils
description: The ship's coils could power Petra's new compass.

stages.objective_text: Bring Petra 3 Aether Coils. (report to Petra the Cartographer)

title: Captain's Log
description: Whoever rules the ship has the Captain's log. Petra wants it.

stages.description: Slay the Captain of the Meridian or MERIDIAN.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Captain of the Meridian or MERIDIAN.
Report back to Petra the Cartographer.

title: Sweet and Dangerous
description: Ilse needs royal jelly for a strength tonic.

stages.objective_text: Bring Ilse 3 Royal Jelly. (report to Sister Ilse)

title: The Swarm in the Fields
description: The hive's swarms are stripping the fields. Ilse wants them stopped.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Chitin Hive.
Report back to Sister Ilse.

title: Statues for My Garden
description: Lady Vos wants statues from the Gorgon's Garden. Real ones. Former adventurers, ideally.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Gorgon's Garden.
Report back to Lady Seraphine Vos.

title: Tears of Stone
description: Vos also wants gorgon tears for her cabinet.

stages.objective_text: Bring Lady Vos 3 Gorgon Tears. (report to Lady Seraphine Vos)

title: Raids on the Road
description: Something from the Stormcrown Eyrie is raiding the eastern road.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Stormcrown Eyrie.
Report back to Warden Sorrel.

title: The Eggs
description: Sorrel wants to know whether the Thunderbird's eggs are safe, or a danger.

stages.description: Slay the Harpy Queen or the Thunderbird Fledgling.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Harpy Queen or the Thunderbird Fledgling.
Report back to Warden Sorrel.

title: The Silent Archive
description: Under Verath is an archive the System won't talk about. Tolven wants to see it.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Silent Archive.
Report back to Archivist Tolven.

title: Memories in Crystal
description: Tolven wants data crystals to study.

stages.objective_text: Bring Tolven 3 Data Crystals. (report to Archivist Tolven)

title: The Auditor
description: Tolven has heard the System sends Auditors. He wants proof they can be beaten.

stages.description: Slay a System Auditor or the Corrupted Index.
stages.objective_text: Slay a System Auditor or the Corrupted Index.
Report back to Archivist Tolven.

title: A Mirror for the Collection
description: Lady Vos wants the Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors cleared so her agents can collect a mirror.

stages.description: Clear the Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors.
Report back to Lady Seraphine Vos.

title: Silvered Shards
description: She also wants shards from the broken mirrors.

stages.objective_text: Bring Lady Vos 3 Silvered Shards. (report to Lady Seraphine Vos)

title: The River Tides
description: The river tides near Verath are wrong. Cassian blames the Drowned Bell.

stages.description: Clear the Temple of the Drowned Bell.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Temple of the Drowned Bell.
Report back to Brother Cassian.

title: Pearls for the Pilgrims
description: Pilgrims who drowned in the temple need their pearls returned to rest.

stages.objective_text: Bring Cassian 3 Abyssal Pearls. (report to Brother Cassian)

title: The Bell Falls Silent
description: Cassian wants the bell silenced for good.

stages.description: Slay the Bell-Ringer Kraken or the Bell's Voice.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Bell-Ringer Kraken or the Bell's Voice.
Report back to Brother Cassian.

title: Prophets on the Road
description: Cultists from the Starfall Crater are preaching on Verath's road. Venn wants to know what they want.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Starfall Crater.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Star Metal
description: Venn's armourers want star metal.

stages.objective_text: Bring Venn 3 Star Metal. (report to Captain Dara Venn)

title: The Prophet
description: Venn wants the cult's prophet silenced.

stages.description: Slay the Prophet of the Starfall Cult or the Star-Eater.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Prophet of the Starfall Cult or the Star-Eater.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Thieves at the Engine
description: Someone has been stealing capacitors from the Lightning Engine. Mabb's recruits want a share.

stages.objective_text: Bring Mabb 3 Storm Capacitors. (report to Sergeant Mabb)

title: Shut It Down
description: The Lightning Engine is draining Verath's lights. Mabb wants it shut down.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Lightning Engine.
Report back to Sergeant Mabb.

title: An Egg for My Cabinet
description: Lady Vos wants a phoenix egg. She's heard there's a mercenary company digging for one.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Phoenix Ashery.
Report back to Lady Seraphine Vos.

title: Cinders as Proof
description: She wants phoenix cinders as proof you've been there.

stages.objective_text: Bring Lady Vos 2 Phoenix Cinders. (report to Lady Seraphine Vos)

title: The Egg-Thieves
description: The mercenaries are competition. Vos wants them gone, or the phoenix itself.

stages.description: Slay the Egg-Thief Company or Ignis Reborn.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Egg-Thief Company or Ignis Reborn.
Report back to Lady Seraphine Vos.

title: Lost Afternoons
description: People in Verath keep losing whole afternoons. Tolven traces it to the Clocktower of Stopped Hours.

stages.description: Clear the Clocktower of Stopped Hours.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Clocktower of Stopped Hours.
Report back to Archivist Tolven.

title: Shards of Time
description: Tolven wants chronoshards to see what moment the tower stopped on.

stages.objective_text: Bring Tolven 2 Chronoshards. (report to Archivist Tolven)

title: The Time Thief
description: Something is stealing time. Tolven wants it caught.

stages.description: Slay the Time Thief or the Keeper of Hours.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Time Thief or the Keeper of Hours.
Report back to Archivist Tolven.

title: Midnight Bells
description: The bells of Bellfall keep Verath awake. Cassian wants to go and say a requiem.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Cathedral of Bellfall.
Report back to Brother Cassian.

title: The Bishop's Sermon
description: Cassian wants the Bishop's sermon finished, so the congregation can rest.

stages.description: Slay the Bishop or the Risen Congregation.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Bishop or the Risen Congregation.
Report back to Brother Cassian.

title: Bronze for the Graves
description: Bell-bronze will mark the graves of the congregation.

stages.objective_text: Bring Cassian 3 Cracked Bell Bronze. (report to Brother Cassian)

title: The Miners' Complaint
description: The miners east of Verath have abandoned their tunnels. Venn wants to know why.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Hoard of Vael-Ashar.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Scales for the Treasury
description: The city treasury will accept dragon scale in lieu of taxes, for once.

stages.objective_text: Bring Venn 3 Dragon Scales. (report to Captain Dara Venn)

title: The Dragon
description: Venn wants the dragon, or its heir, dead.

stages.description: Slay Vael-Ashar, his dracolich, or his heir.
stages.objective_text: Slay Vael-Ashar, his dracolich, or his heir.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: The Green Glow
description: Odo has heard of a reactor that turns the arcane arts into fuel. He's terrified and fascinated.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Thaumic Reactor.
Report back to Tinker Odo.

title: Slag Samples
description: Odo wants reactor slag, in a lead box, at arm's length.

stages.objective_text: Bring Odo 3 Reactor Slag. (report to Tinker Odo)

title: Meltdown
description: Odo says the reactor must be stopped before it melts down.

stages.description: Slay the Meltdown Elemental or Director of the Reactor.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Meltdown Elemental or Director of the Reactor.
Report back to Tinker Odo.

title: Light on the Mountain
description: Aldane wants to know who, or what, is watching the sky from the Dawnspire Observatory.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Dawnspire Observatory.
Report back to Magister Aldane.

title: Feathers of the Watchers
description: Aldane wants seraph feathers to see what the watchers see.

stages.objective_text: Bring Aldane 3 Seraph Feathers. (report to Magister Aldane)

title: What the Seraph Saw
description: The Seraph said the System is not what you think. Aldane needs you to face whatever now holds the Lens.

stages.description: Slay the Watching Seraph or the Eye in the Lens.
stages.objective_text: Slay the Watching Seraph or the Eye in the Lens.
Report back to Magister Aldane.

title: The Rift You Dream
description: Aldane has had the same nightmare as everyone in Verath. He wants you to find where it comes from.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Dreamer's Abyss.
Report back to Magister Aldane.

title: The Unmaking
description: Aldane thinks the Dreamer and the Hollow of Unmaking are connected. Go and see.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Hollow of Unmaking.
Report back to Magister Aldane.

title: Ichor and Void
description: Bring back proof from both rifts.

stages.description: Bring Aldane 2 Dream Ichor and 1 Void Essence.
stages.objective_text: Bring Aldane 2 Dream Ichor and 1 Void Essence. (report to Magister Aldane)

title: A Reading at the Roots
description: Petra's compass spins near rifts that aren't on any register. She needs a calibration run through the Rootdeep Caverns, and then she thinks she can find a new one.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Rootdeep Caverns.
Report back to Petra the Cartographer.

title: The First Uncharted Rift
description: Petra's reading found a rift nobody has registered. Go in, clear it, and come back with a map.

stages.objective_text: Clear a newly opened (uncharted) Gate.
Report back to Petra the Cartographer.

title: Deeper Echoes
description: Petra thinks the old rifts are echoing, deeper each time. She needs someone strong enough to follow the echoes down.

stages.objective_text: Reach level 10.
Report back to Petra the Cartographer.

title: Rift Cartographer
description: The last reading points at the Clocktower of Stopped Hours. If time is broken there, so is space. Clear it and Petra will chart a rift no one has ever seen.

stages.description: Clear the Clocktower of Stopped Hours.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Clocktower of Stopped Hours.
Report back to Petra the Cartographer.

title: Strength in Numbers
description: Some Gates are too much for one adventurer. Ostra wants to see you lead a party through the Hydra Fen.

stages.description: Clear the Hydra Fen (a group Gate: bring companions).
stages.objective_text: Clear the Hydra Fen (a group Gate: bring companions).
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: The Bell Tolls for Parties
description: The Drowned Bell is a group Gate too. Ostra wants it cleared by a proper party.

stages.description: Clear the Temple of the Drowned Bell (group Gate).
stages.objective_text: Clear the Temple of the Drowned Bell (group Gate).
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Into the Hoard Together
description: A party of three, Ostra says, and not one fewer, for the Hoard of Vael-Ashar.

stages.description: Clear the Hoard of Vael-Ashar (group Gate).
stages.objective_text: Clear the Hoard of Vael-Ashar (group Gate).
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: The Dreamers' Party
description: The hardest Gate on the register takes four. Gather the best adventurers in Verath and wake up together.

stages.description: Clear the Dreamer's Abyss (group Gate, party of 4).
stages.objective_text: Clear the Dreamer's Abyss (group Gate, party of 4).
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Bronze for the Forge
description: Halvard always needs bronze that moves. Don't ask what for. Labyrinth Bronze comes from the Bronze Labyrinth.

stages.objective_text: Bring Forgemaster Halvard 2 Labyrinth Bronze. (report to Forgemaster Halvard)

title: Glass That Sings
description: Aldane is studying how dewglass holds sound. Fae Dewglass comes from the Hollow Under the Hill.

stages.objective_text: Bring Magister Aldane 2 Fae Dewglass. (report to Magister Aldane)

title: Scales for Arrowheads
description: Brannoc makes the best arrowheads from hydra scale. Hydra Scale comes from the Hydra Fen.

stages.objective_text: Bring Old Brannoc 3 Hydra Scale. (report to Old Brannoc)

title: Stone Tears
description: Ilse grinds gorgon tears into a balm for stiff joints. Gorgon Tear comes from the Gorgon's Garden.

stages.objective_text: Bring Sister Ilse 2 Gorgon Tear. (report to Sister Ilse)

title: Black Pearls
description: Lady Vos has a necklace with a gap in it. Abyssal Pearl comes from the Temple of the Drowned Bell.

stages.description: Bring Lady Seraphine Vos 2 Abyssal Pearl.
stages.objective_text: Bring Lady Seraphine Vos 2 Abyssal Pearl. (report to Lady Seraphine Vos)

title: A Cinder for the Furnace
description: Halvard's furnace has gone cold, and only a phoenix cinder will relight it the way he wants. Phoenix Cinder comes from the Phoenix Ashery.

stages.objective_text: Bring Forgemaster Halvard 1 Phoenix Cinder. (report to Forgemaster Halvard)

title: Dragon Scale
description: Lady Vos wants to tile a bathroom. Don't ask. Dragon Scale comes from the Hoard of Vael-Ashar.

stages.description: Bring Lady Seraphine Vos 2 Dragon Scale.
stages.objective_text: Bring Lady Seraphine Vos 2 Dragon Scale. (report to Lady Seraphine Vos)

title: More Cogs
description: Odo always needs more cogs. Brass Cog comes from the Clockwork Foundry.

stages.objective_text: Bring Tinker Odo 3 Brass Cog. (report to Tinker Odo)

title: Animate Cores
description: Aldane wants to see if a golem core can think. Golem Core Fragment comes from the Golem Assembly Line.

stages.description: Bring Magister Aldane 2 Golem Core Fragment.
stages.objective_text: Bring Magister Aldane 2 Golem Core Fragment. (report to Magister Aldane)

title: Floating Coils
description: Petra wants a floating compass. Aether Coil comes from the Derelict Skyship Meridian.

stages.description: Bring Petra the Cartographer 2 Aether Coil.
stages.objective_text: Bring Petra the Cartographer 2 Aether Coil. (report to Petra the Cartographer)

title: Crystal Memories
description: Tolven wants to read the memories in data crystals. Data Crystal comes from the Silent Archive.

stages.objective_text: Bring Archivist Tolven 2 Data Crystal. (report to Archivist Tolven)

title: Bottled Storms
description: Odo wants to power his workshop. Storm Capacitor comes from the Lightning Engine.

stages.objective_text: Bring Tinker Odo 2 Storm Capacitor. (report to Tinker Odo)

title: Dangerous Samples
description: Aldane has a lead-lined box ready. Reactor Slag comes from the Thaumic Reactor.

stages.objective_text: Bring Magister Aldane 2 Reactor Slag. (report to Magister Aldane)

title: Ghost Jelly
description: Cassian uses ectoplasm to train novice exorcists. Ectoplasm comes from Ashgrove Manor.

stages.objective_text: Bring Brother Cassian 3 Ectoplasm. (report to Brother Cassian)

title: Charms From the Bog
description: Sorrel wants to know which charms are curses. Hag's Charm comes from Grandmother Rook's Bog.

stages.objective_text: Bring Warden Sorrel 2 Hag's Charm. (report to Warden Sorrel)

title: Haunted Porcelain
description: Cassian wants the dolls' faces laid to rest. Haunted Porcelain comes from the Dollmaker's Workshop.

stages.objective_text: Bring Brother Cassian 2 Haunted Porcelain. (report to Brother Cassian)

title: Ash for a Cure
description: Ilse is working on a cure for the asylum plague. Plague Ash comes from Saint Vera's Asylum.

stages.objective_text: Bring Sister Ilse 2 Plague Ash. (report to Sister Ilse)

title: Late Reflections
description: Aldane is studying why reflections lag. Silvered Shard comes from the Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors.

stages.objective_text: Bring Magister Aldane 2 Silvered Shard. (report to Magister Aldane)

title: Bell-Bronze
description: Halvard wants to cast a new bell for Verath. Cracked Bell Bronze comes from the Cathedral of Bellfall.

stages.description: Bring Forgemaster Halvard 2 Cracked Bell Bronze.
stages.objective_text: Bring Forgemaster Halvard 2 Cracked Bell Bronze. (report to Forgemaster Halvard)

title: Living Stone
description: Petra uses heartstone to calibrate compasses. Heartstone Chip comes from the Rootdeep Caverns.

stages.description: Bring Petra the Cartographer 3 Heartstone Chip.
stages.objective_text: Bring Petra the Cartographer 3 Heartstone Chip. (report to Petra the Cartographer)

title: Ore That Glows
description: Odo wants to make a lamp that never goes out. Ember Ore comes from the Cinder Forge.

stages.objective_text: Bring Tinker Odo 3 Ember Ore. (report to Tinker Odo)

title: Pearls of the Tide
description: Ilse uses tide pearls to tell when the rains will come. Tide Pearl comes from the Tidecall Grotto.

stages.objective_text: Bring Sister Ilse 2 Tide Pearl. (report to Sister Ilse)

title: Ice for the Wounded
description: Mabb's recruits keep spraining things. Everfrost Shard comes from the Rime Tomb.

stages.objective_text: Bring Sergeant Mabb 2 Everfrost Shard. (report to Sergeant Mabb)

title: Feathers for Fletching
description: Sorrel fletches arrows that never miss with these. Thunderbird Feather comes from the Stormcrown Eyrie.

stages.objective_text: Bring Warden Sorrel 2 Thunderbird Feather. (report to Warden Sorrel)

title: A Drop of Nothing
description: Tolven wants to know what nothing weighs. Void Essence comes from the Hollow of Unmaking.

stages.objective_text: Bring Archivist Tolven 1 Void Essence. (report to Archivist Tolven)

title: Bounty on Redcaps
description: The village pays a bounty on Redcap badges. Redcap Insignia comes from Redcap Fortress.

stages.objective_text: Bring Registrar Ostra 4 Redcap Insignia. (report to Registrar Ostra)

title: Glowing Spores
description: Petra wants a lantern that glows when she's happy. Glowcap Spore Sac comes from the Mycelial Kingdom.

stages.description: Bring Petra the Cartographer 3 Glowcap Spore Sac.
stages.objective_text: Bring Petra the Cartographer 3 Glowcap Spore Sac. (report to Petra the Cartographer)

title: Strength Tonic
description: Mabb swears by royal jelly. Royal Jelly comes from the Chitin Hive.

stages.objective_text: Bring Sergeant Mabb 2 Royal Jelly. (report to Sergeant Mabb)

title: Metal From the Sky
description: Halvard has always wanted to work star metal. Star Metal comes from the Starfall Crater.

stages.objective_text: Bring Forgemaster Halvard 2 Star Metal. (report to Forgemaster Halvard)

title: A Moment in Glass
description: Aldane wants to measure time itself. Chronoshard comes from the Clocktower of Stopped Hours.

stages.objective_text: Bring Magister Aldane 1 Chronoshard. (report to Magister Aldane)

title: Feathers of Light
description: Cassian wants to bless the city gates with seraph feathers. Seraph Feather comes from the Dawnspire Observatory.

stages.objective_text: Bring Brother Cassian 2 Seraph Feather. (report to Brother Cassian)

title: Bottled Dreams
description: Lady Vos wants to dream of somewhere else. Dream Ichor comes from the Dreamer's Abyss.

stages.description: Bring Lady Seraphine Vos 2 Dream Ichor.
stages.objective_text: Bring Lady Seraphine Vos 2 Dream Ichor. (report to Lady Seraphine Vos)

title: Gate Bounty: Ashgrove Manor
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on Ashgrove Manor. A manor house that burned down a century ago stands whole again inside a rift by the village well. Its windows are lit every night. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear Ashgrove Manor.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: The Clockwork Foundry
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Clockwork Foundry. A pre-Fracture workshop, dug out of a hillside near the village, ticks like a giant pocket watch. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Clockwork Foundry.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: The Bronze Labyrinth
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Bronze Labyrinth. A rift in a sheep field outside the village opens onto corridors of green bronze that rearrange themselves when no one is looking. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Bronze Labyrinth.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: Redcap Fortress
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on Redcap Fortress. A ruined border fort, swallowed by a rift on the village road, has been taken over by bandits who dip their caps in their victims' blood. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear Redcap Fortress.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: The Rootdeep Caverns
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Rootdeep Caverns. A rift under an old oak near the village leads into caves where the roots of the world run like veins through living stone. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Rootdeep Caverns.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: The Mycelial Kingdom
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Mycelial Kingdom. A rift in the forest floor opens into caves of giant mushrooms that glow in the dark. Spores drift out of it on the wind and make the village dogs dream. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Mycelial Kingdom.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: The Golem Assembly Line
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Golem Assembly Line. A rift into a factory that made war golems for a kingdom that no longer exists. The line still runs. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Golem Assembly Line.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: The Cinder Forge
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Cinder Forge. A rift that opened on the slopes above the village glows red at night. The System calls it a FORGE-CLASS GATE. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Cinder Forge.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: Grandmother Rook's Bog
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on Grandmother Rook's Bog. A rift in the wetlands near the camp, full of crooked trees hung with charms. Livestock in the area have started to vanish. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear Grandmother Rook's Bog.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: The Hollow Under the Hill
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Hollow Under the Hill. A ring of white mushrooms by the roadside camp has become a door. People who step in come out a day later, sure only an hour has passed. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.description: Clear the Hollow Under the Hill.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Hollow Under the Hill.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: The Tidecall Grotto
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Tidecall Grotto. A rift on the lakeshore by the camp opens onto a sea cave, though there is no sea for a hundred miles. The tide comes in twice a day. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Tidecall Grotto.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: The Dollmaker's Workshop
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Dollmaker's Workshop. A toyshop on a Verath side street was swallowed by a rift. Through the window, the dolls on the shelves have been rearranged every morning. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Dollmaker's Workshop.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: The Hydra Fen
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Hydra Fen. South of the village a rift has drowned an orchard. The water is warm, and something under it breathes in nine places at once. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Hydra Fen.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: The Rime Tomb
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Rime Tomb. A rift in the northern hills opens into a tomb of blue ice. The kings buried in it are frozen in mid-step, and their eyes follow you. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Rime Tomb.
Report back to Registrar Ostra.

title: Gate Bounty: Saint Vera's Asylum
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on Saint Vera's Asylum. An asylum for the sick, abandoned after a plague long ago, has surfaced in a rift outside Verath's walls. Its bell rings for meals no one eats. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear Saint Vera's Asylum.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Chitin Hive
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Chitin Hive. A rift outside Verath is surrounded by a mound of hardened mud the size of a hill. Things buzz inside it day and night. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Chitin Hive.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Derelict Skyship Meridian
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Derelict Skyship Meridian. A flying ship from before the Fracture hangs in a rift above the forest, motionless, its running lights still blinking. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Derelict Skyship Meridian.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Gorgon's Garden
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Gorgon's Garden. A walled garden of statues, every one of them an adventurer, every one of them wearing the same last expression. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Gorgon's Garden.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Stormcrown Eyrie
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Stormcrown Eyrie. A rift has lifted a mountaintop into the sky above the eastern road. Lightning strikes it a hundred times a day. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Stormcrown Eyrie.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors. A carnival tent pitched in a rift in Verath's market district. Everyone who enters comes out swearing they saw themselves die. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.description: Clear the Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Hall of Ten Thousand Mirrors.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Silent Archive
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Silent Archive. A rift beneath Verath opens into a vault full of humming crystal pillars. The System's own records call it an ARCHIVE NODE, and then refuse to say more. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Silent Archive.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Temple of the Drowned Bell
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Temple of the Drowned Bell. A rift in the river near Verath opens on a sea temple, its pillars hung with weed. A bell tolls under the water at every high tide. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.description: Clear the Temple of the Drowned Bell.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Temple of the Drowned Bell.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Starfall Crater
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Starfall Crater. A star fell during the Fracture and made a crater by the road to Verath. The System upgraded it to a Gate when the crater started to glow. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Starfall Crater.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Lightning Engine
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Lightning Engine. A copper spire stands in a rift west of Verath, wrapped in coils and crowned with a crackling sphere. Birds that fly near it never land again. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Lightning Engine.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Phoenix Ashery
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Phoenix Ashery. A hill north of Verath burns without fuel. The System registers it as a Gate, and as a nest. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Phoenix Ashery.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Clocktower of Stopped Hours
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Clocktower of Stopped Hours. A clocktower in Verath that stopped at the moment of the Fracture. Those who enter come out older, or younger, or not at all. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.description: Clear the Clocktower of Stopped Hours.
stages.objective_text: Clear the Clocktower of Stopped Hours.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Cathedral of Bellfall
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Cathedral of Bellfall. A cathedral that sank into the ground during the Fracture, congregation and all. Its spire still pokes from a rift east of Verath, and its bells ring at midnight. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Cathedral of Bellfall.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Hoard of Vael-Ashar
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Hoard of Vael-Ashar. A mountain rift east of Verath, rated A-class. Its first master was a dragon who has slept on his gold since before the Fracture. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Hoard of Vael-Ashar.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Dawnspire Observatory
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Dawnspire Observatory. An observatory on a mountain peak, its dome always open to the sky. Light pours out of it at night, and the System says it's a Gate to somewhere bright. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Dawnspire Observatory.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Thaumic Reactor
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Thaumic Reactor. A sealed facility from before the Fracture, where someone tried to make the arcane arts into fuel. The rift around it glows a faint, sick green. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Thaumic Reactor.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Hollow of Unmaking
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Hollow of Unmaking. A rift full of void, the same stuff as the Fracture's wound. The System marks it with a red border and a single word: DON'T. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Hollow of Unmaking.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.

title: Gate Bounty: The Dreamer's Abyss
description: The Registry has posted a bounty on the Dreamer's Abyss. A rift that only opens when you sleep. People who find it wake screaming, or don't wake. The System rates it S-class and will not say why. Clear it, whoever its master is this week.

stages.objective_text: Clear the Dreamer's Abyss.
Report back to Captain Dara Venn.
